author: Vox
description:
Christa Pike was going to be the first woman executed in Tennessee. But she survived two doses of the lethal injection. Vox’s Miles Bryan talked to journalist and author Pamela Colloff about what this case opens up about the wider issues  with the death penalty.

author: Vox
description:
A couple in California has been charged with child abuse as part of a surrogacy scandal that left them with more than 20 children. 

Ava Kofman, a staff writer for The New Yorker, followed the journey of Kayla Elliot, who carried a child for the couple in 2024, and the moment she learned the horrible truth behind her pregnancy.
